text:
alex chan: Heads-up — noticed a confusing edge case in the console where a tenant-scoped role + route fallback makes the UI show the user as having a route-level 'write' permission when they actually only have delegated 'read' via an inherited role. :thinking:
maya singh: Ugh. Is this the scenario where routing policy falls back to a cheaper model variant and the route-level capability flag gets computed post-routing?
devon rao: yeah, looks like our effective-perms calc runs after routing decision. so when fallback swaps in a permissive variant we accidentally mark route as writable in the preview.
sara kim: can we show two values in the UI: declared permissions (what admin gave) vs effective (what the routing+quota stack allows)? Simple toggle? :eyes:
alex chan: I tried returning both from the API but current schema only accepts one `effective_permissions` array. Quick snippet I mocked:
```
{
  "declared_permissions": ["route.read"],
  "effective_permissions": ["route.read","route.write"],
  "resolution_path": ["role:Tenant-Editor","policy:route-fallback"]
}
```
devon rao: good idea. API change required but small. also we should include `resolution_path` so console can surface why effective differs.
maya singh: microcopy is important — folks will panic seeing `write` when they didn't grant it. Maybe show a badge: "effective via fallback — not directly granted" with a tooltip explaining routing fallback + quota.
sara kim: telemetry ask: can we add counters for `perm_resolution_mismatch` and tag by route/model/tenant? need to track how often this happens before we change UX.
infra-bot: deploy queued: perms-service v2.14.1 -> staging (sha: d4c3b2) :rocket:
alex chan: also can we sample full eval logs for 1% of mismatches and send to internal S3 for audit? reference RFC: https://rwd/internal/rfcs/PLAT-231 (permission resolution tracing)
maya singh: for rollout UX, we should do a canary: opt-in preview for all tenant admins for 1 week, collect feedback, then flip default.
devon rao: plan: 1) API change to return `declared_permissions`, `effective_permissions`, `resolution_path` 2) add telemetry metric `perm_resolution_mismatch_count` 3) Console: show dual view with clear badge & CTA to expand path 4) Canary to tenant-admins + telemetry for 2 weeks. I'll open an implementation ticket.
sara kim: +1. add a quick grafana panel -> show top 10 routes by mismatch rate and response latency for perm calc.
alex chan: created ticket PLAT-3476 and added the mockups to the ticket. tagging @maya for copy. Thanks folks. :+1:
maya singh: I'll draft microcopy this afternoon and post in the ticket. thanks!
